summary: BayCom Corp filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of Michael J. Perdue as a director effective April 22, 2026. Mr. Perdue brings over 40 years of community banking leadership and will serve on the Compensation and Nominating Committees. The appointment is a routine board addition with standard director compensation per the 2025 proxy. No other material plans, arrangements, or transactions were disclosed. This filing lacks characteristics of an activist campaign, management change event, or other special situation, as it reflects an ordinary board appointment.
